ActorTalk: This tech... there's more to it than it looks.
What do you mean, "there's more to it than it looks"?
I'm talking about the holographic system.
Back when Babylonia almost fell, everything was chaos. Our captain even got trapped in a bathroom by a broken security system.
We almost became the most ridiculous non-combat casualties in history.
This thing didn't throw a single error. It even synced with the security system to monitor everyone's vitals... I checked the backend myself—it ran flawlessly the whole time.
It's supposed to be just a display piece, and yet it's incredible. It even capped things off with Ode to Joy and a full-on light show.
Which Engineering Force genius came down from the heavens to take on this side gig?
I'd love to know that myself.
If I had to guess, it was probably Teddy.
But I'm more curious about who your captain is.
